questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: A gold is used in jewellery.
The gold is used in jewellery.
An gold is used in jewellery.
questions.explanation: Material nouns used in a general sense usually take no article.

questions.question: Complete the sentence: ___ silver in this necklace is genuine.
questions.explanation: The article 'the' is used because the sentence refers to specific silver in a particular necklace.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: The wood is used to make furniture.
Wood is used to make furniture.
A wood is used to make furniture.
An wood is used to make furniture.
questions.correctAnswer: Wood is used to make furniture.
questions.explanation: Wood as a general material is uncountable and normally takes no article.

questions.question: Complete the sentence: The workers used ___ iron supplied by the factory.
questions.explanation: The sentence identifies a particular supply of iron.

questions.question: Which sentence uses 'glass' as a material noun?
questions.explanation: Here, 'glass' refers to the material, not a drinking container.

questions.question: Complete the sentence: My father bought ___ gold medal for the competition.
questions.explanation: The phrase 'a gold medal' refers to one countable object. 'Gold' describes its material.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: Cotton is grown in many parts of India.
A cotton is grown in many parts of India.
An cotton is grown in many parts of India.
The cotton is grown in many parts of India.
questions.correctAnswer: Cotton is grown in many parts of India.
questions.explanation: Cotton used as a general material or crop takes no article.

questions.question: Complete the sentence: ___ plastic used in these bottles is recyclable.
questions.explanation: The sentence refers to the particular plastic used in these bottles.

questions.question: Which sentence uses 'paper' as a countable noun?
options: The paper used for printing is expensive.
She submitted a paper at the conference.
questions.correctAnswer: She submitted a paper at the conference.
questions.explanation: Here, 'a paper' means an academic article or written research document.

questions.question: Complete the sentence: The sculpture was made of ___ stone.
questions.explanation: Stone is used as a material noun in this general description.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: The copper is a good conductor of electricity.
Copper is a good conductor of electricity.
A copper is a good conductor of electricity.
An copper is a good conductor of electricity.
questions.correctAnswer: Copper is a good conductor of electricity.
questions.explanation: Copper as a general material takes no article.

questions.question: Complete the sentence: We examined ___ oil extracted from this plant.
questions.explanation: The phrase identifies a specific quantity or type of oil extracted from this plant.

questions.question: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: A furniture is made of wood.
The furniture is made of a wood.
An furniture is made of wood.
questions.explanation: Furniture and wood are both used as general uncountable nouns here.

questions.question: Complete the sentence: This ring is made of ___ pure gold.
questions.explanation: Pure gold refers to the material in general. The adjective 'pure' does not make it countable.
